app_fee.value: No application fee for CSU graduate programs (external application fees aside).
app_fee.quote: There is no application fee to apply to CSU for Graduate Programs

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no application fee to apply to CSU for Graduate Programs

gre_general.value: Entrance exam scores are not required centrally; requirements are set program by program.
gre_general.quote: Not all programs require entrance exam scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 78, with at least 17 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (Internet-Based): 78 and at least 17 in each section

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum of 6.0 overall, with at least 5.0 in each section.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 6.0 and at least 5.0 in each section

english_waiver.value: A U.S. degree or a degree from a TOEFL-exempt country waives the test; the country list is on a page I could not open, so an Indian English-medium degree is unconfirmed.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of graduation from a secondary school or accredited college/university in the U.S. or from one of the TOEFL exempted countries
